stages.title: AI-native plan editing - prompt to diff to confirm to apply
stages.notes: Deliver G1 per docs/CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md (G1) + CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md rows G1.1/G1.2. REUSE, do not fork: PlanImportService.ImportAsync (prose->advisor->plan), PlanDiff.Compute/Apply, and the Face import-diff view (plan.go renderImportDiff). G1.1: teach POST /plan/import (or a sibling /plan/prompt) to route freeform prose through the advisor(Fable) model instead of 400-ing, returning the same diff/confirm/apply contract; contract tests. G1.2: a Plan-tab Prompt box that posts the prompt and renders the returned PlanDiffDto with the existing view, a=apply/esc=cancel; goldens + a unit test driving the keys. Gate: curl {"source":"add a lint gate that runs dotnet format","apply":false} returns a diff with the gate; apply:true persists + bumps planVersion; invalid result rejected without writing.

stages.title: Kanban board - live task graph with move/add actions
stages.notes: Deliver G2 per docs/CONDUCTOR-AI-NATIVE.md (G2) + rows G2.1/G2.2. REUSE: GET /tasks + TaskDto + TaskGraph; the MCP task_update/task_add write semantics (McpTaskServer.Handlers) - factor the shared write so HTTP and MCP can't drift. G2.1: POST /tasks/update {taskId,status} + POST /tasks/add {checkpointId,title,order} emitting TaskStatusChanged/TaskAdded; contract tests. G2.2: a Kanban tab (11th tab, mnemonic b for board; reachable by b + tab-cycle - there is NO spare digit past 0, do not imply one) with columns TODO/In-Progress/Done from GET /tasks, up/down select, left/right move a card across columns (POST /tasks/update), n add under the selected checkpoint (POST /tasks/add), re-fetch after a write; demo-source mirror + goldens at 80x24/120x30/200x50. Gate: POST /tasks/add then GET /tasks shows the card in TODO; update to done moves it; a Face golden shows three populated columns.
